name: Porcelain Doll
source:
Yuu is a 19 year old freshman at university, who returns home to discover that the lake she tried to throw herself into has begun to change her into a more "perfect" version of herself. Will you resist the urge to chip away every imperfection, or will you let her finally be the perfect Yuu?

[From [url=https://sugarcoatedmoth.itch.io/porcelain-doll]itch.io[/url]]
